acceptance_rules: Declared mode, admission status string, cap0 or NoNewPrivs alone cannot establish the domain
Container cgroup namespace may report 0::/ only after Root binds it to the observed dedicated outer cgroup; this does not satisfy frozen bwrap preflight
Rootful identity user mappings may be accepted only as the exact separately observed Root-native container domain; no nested user namespace pass inferred
No automatic fallback from any failed bwrap/unshare attempt; entry selection is explicit before the job and both result domains remain distinct
Existing 349-package bootstrap is an input environment, not a successful LLVM build or source/runtime qualification
Actual new source/static checks, compiler execution, stage ELF geometry/private linkage and signed lifecycle must retain distinct evidence
prerequisites: Root must independently bind this exact entry/controller/image/source/policy and observed domain before upstream execution
Verified local pinned source archive or Root-bound freshly extracted source; no preexisting LLVM23 binary required
Root initializes work/dest/opt/cachy-asahi/llvm23-source-reference plus home and tmp before container creation; prefix may be empty
Source read-only, driver read-only, root filesystem read-only; writable work with final-prefix read-only alias from the same owned stage
Root-owned timeout, bounded logs, signal handling, exclusive child retirement and exact container retirement
required_root_observations: Exact Docker actor ID, inspected image ID/native architecture, actual create argv and source/driver/controller hashes
Inspect Config/HostConfig/Mounts plus observed root/source/driver/work/prefix mountinfo, device/inode alias binding and mount flags
Guest architecture, native page size, kernel UID/GID/groups, full capability fields, NoNewPrivs, Seccomp, UID/GID maps
Guest process PID/starttime/exe/cmdline/parent/namespace identities joined to outer container State.Pid and observed host/init lineage
Actual host and guest cgroup identities, memory/swap/CPU/PID limits joined to outer inspected resources; available host memory/disk/inodes
Actual network namespace and interfaces; no host networking, devices, Docker sockets or unbound mounts
Entry-to-child identity/domain continuity before each fixed upstream phase; exact exit/retirement evidence before success
